solution_summary: Telecom operators today face a rapid influx of artificial intelligence, orchestration, and automation tools. But converting these technologies into real business value is a constant challenge. To prove the business case and drive a return on investment (ROI), operators need a clear way to simplify their daily workflows. There's plenty of tools and technologies out there—AI, orchestration, automation. But how do we convert those tools and those technologies into delivering real business value? Google Cloud provides us with sophisticated tools that allow us to rapidly determine what the business value can be to help our customers move forward. Ericsson addressed this by defining the desired business outcome first and working backward to build the solution.
